timescoring.note: Hypotheses are a set of event intervals over the whole recording; abstained time can only be scored as 'no event'.

sed_eval.note: Segment metrics are computed over segments spanned by the reference and estimate lists; there is no per-system scored region.

cpsc2021.design: Scores onset/offset positions within beat tolerances and a record-level class; AF and AFL are pooled; no notion of unanswered time.
